title: 第9章 库亚塔VS亚菲特
slug: 魔兽剑圣异界纵横全本免费-魔兽剑圣异界纵横最新章节列表
content_zh:
跟在库亚塔身边，众人走上了一短顺利的路程。
听着库亚塔边走边介绍的魔兽分布，以及它们的阶级。
众人是冷汗直从额头不住的流淌而下。
“实在是太侥幸了。。。。”
这是所有人此时内心的所想。
只要库亚塔刚刚所说的那些魔兽，随便出来个俩三头，他们这点人，可能就只得全军覆没了。
“你们在这里面，不要搞出太大的声响出来，很多魔兽都不喜欢吵闹，惹得冒火，冲出来一顿横扫，你们就直接挨着吧，还有。”说到这里的库亚塔顿了一下，瞟了一眼刘枫，道：“还是就是不要轻视这里的任何一只魔兽，它们的智慧非常高，至少不你你们差。”
被库亚塔瞟到的刘枫有些尴尬的摸了摸鼻子。
苏菲见状，不由捂着小嘴娇笑。
***************
现在已经很临近黑龙的地盘所在了，淡淡的龙威开始散发开来，在这龙威笼罩的地盘中，斗气以及魔力的运转都要比在平常要晦涩许多。
刘枫也是悄悄的运转了俩圈真气，不过还好，也许是因为真气是并不属于这是世界的力量，龙威对它的威慑极其弱小，小到甚至可以忽略不计。
突然，一声惊天动地的狮吼响起，吼叫声中似乎还夹杂着痛苦。
紧接着，一声撕破天际的龙吟也想了起来。
听见龙吟声，众人心中猛的一颤，巨龙。。大陆除神之外颠峰的存在，这次他们的目标。
库亚塔听见那声狮吼后，面色不由一变，回头催促道：“快，快点，狮巴正在和黑龙战斗，我们快去。”
说完，带头就向龙吟声传来的地方奔驰而去，众人赶紧相随而上。
树枝在耳边飞过，树干在迅速后退。
在疾奔了俩三分钟之后，前方幕的一亮，目光开阔了起来，看着眼前的场景，众人眼求剧缩，就连刘枫心脏也是猛的一跳。
视线几十米外，一头巨大的魔兽正在和黑龙亚菲特对恃。

巨大的身躯，直有七八米高大，狮头，怪尾，鹿角，象极了地球上传说中的瑞兽，“麒麟。”
而另一边，则是黑龙亚菲特，长约十几米的身躯，庞大的鳞片附于其上，闪耀着墨色光芒，一双黑色巨翅不住的扇动，吹得周围的树木摇晃不已，龙口之中，黑色烟雾喷出，吹散，喷出，吹散。
正在对恃的一兽一龙，感觉到了众人的到来，却并没有过于理会，只是把目光放到了库亚塔的身上。
狮巴的目光有些惊喜，而黑龙亚菲特则是有些担忧，若是它全盛时期，哪会将它们放在眼里，可是现在不同，自从那该死的东西从自己肚子里跑出来后，就吸取了它大部分力量，让自己从圣阶顶端掉到了九阶顶端。
“嗷。。。”一声牛吼，库亚塔也是现出本体，十几米高的巨牛，再次现于众人眼内。
踏着巨大的步伐，走到狮巴身边，巨口一张一合，“嘿嘿，老狮，你太不够意思了，打架竟然都不叫上我库亚塔。”
“你这个懒鬼，不是最喜欢睡觉吗？我上次去找你，结果一直等了半个月。”一声巨吼也从狮巴那张合的嘴中冒了出来。
“嘿嘿。。”
“库亚塔，狮巴，不要以为我会怕了你们，若是在我以前，你们这等蝼蚁的存在，怎敢挑衅我黑龙的威严。”一声龙吟声夹杂着人类的语言从亚菲特嘴中吐出。
“哼，亚菲特，你不要以为死亡森林，是你的龙堡，我们死亡森林的魔兽从来不惧你们巨龙，而且你也知道那是你以前，我只知道我们现在不会怕你就是。”库亚塔发出一声冷哼。
狮巴在一旁连连点着那颗巨头，表示赞同。
“一头死牛，竟然如此猖狂，我就来看看你除了找人之外，还有什么本事。”黑老亚菲特怒骂道，扇着巨翅，向库亚塔俯冲而来。
“韩约，你们自己寻找机会下手，我和狮巴拦住它。”
仰头一声巨吼，无数风刃向亚菲特席卷而去，身旁的狮巴也是一口风刃吐出。
看着疾射而来的风刃，亚菲特一口腐蚀龙息喷出，将之消逝的干干净净。
嘲笑的声音传出，“库亚塔，你们难道就之会用这这么弱小的魔法吗？这连我的鳞甲都砍不破。”
不理黑龙的嘲笑，库亚塔一声巨吼，周围树木开始了疯狂的生长，十几米粗的树干宛如毒蛇一般的朝空中的亚菲特缠去。

content_en:
Following Kuyata, everyone walked on a short and smooth journey.
Listening to Kuyata's introduction to the distribution of monsters and their classes while walking.
Everyone was in cold sweat streaming down their foreheads.
"It's such a fluke..."
This is what everyone is thinking at this time.
As long as two or three of those monsters that Kuyata just mentioned appeared randomly, they might have to be wiped out.
"You guys in here, don't make too much noise. Many monsters don't like to make noise. If they get angry, they rush out and sweep them away. You just get next to each other. Also." After saying this, Kuyata paused, glanced at Liu Feng, and said, "Just don't underestimate any monster here. Their intelligence is very high, at least not as good as you."
Liu Feng, who was caught by Kuyata, touched his nose in embarrassment.
When Sophie saw this, she couldn't help but cover her mouth and smile.
***************
Now that we are very close to the black dragon's territory, a faint dragon's power begins to spread. In this territory shrouded by the dragon's power, the operation of fighting spirit and magic power is much more obscure than usual.
Liu Feng also quietly circulated his true energy for two rounds, but it was okay. Maybe it was because true energy did not belong to the power of this world, and Long Wei's deterrent against it was extremely weak, so small that it could even be ignored.
Suddenly, an earth-shattering lion roar sounded, and the roar seemed to be mixed with pain.
Immediately afterwards, a dragon roar that tore through the sky also came to mind.
Hearing the roar of the dragon, everyone's hearts trembled fiercely, the giant dragon. . The continent's pinnacle existence other than gods is their target this time.
After Kuyata heard the lion's roar, his expression changed. He turned around and urged: "Hurry, hurry up, Shiba is fighting the black dragon, let's go quickly."
After saying that, the leader ran towards the place where the dragon roar came from, and everyone quickly followed.
Branches flew past my ears, and the tree trunks retreated rapidly.
After running for two or three minutes, the curtain in front lit up, and their eyes widened. Looking at the scene in front of them, everyone's eyes shrank, and even Liu Feng's heart skipped a beat.
A few tens of meters away, a huge magical beast was confronting the black dragon Yaphet.
The huge body, seven or eight meters tall, with a lion's head, a monster tail, and antlers, is very much like the legendary auspicious beast on the earth, "Qilin."
On the other side, there is the black dragon Yafit, with a body about ten meters long, with huge scales attached to it, shining with ink-colored light. A pair of giant black wings flap continuously, causing the surrounding trees to shake. From the dragon's mouth, black smoke spurts out, blows away, blows out, blows away.
The beasts and dragons who were confronting each other felt the arrival of everyone, but did not pay too much attention to them. They just focused on Kuyata.
Shiba's eyes were a little surprised, while Black Dragon Yaphet was a little worried. If it was in its heyday, it would not take them seriously, but it is different now. Since the damn thing ran out of his stomach, it has absorbed most of its power, causing him to fall from the top of the holy level to the top of the ninth level.
"Ouch..." With a roar, Kuyata also appeared in his true form. The giant bull more than ten meters high appeared in front of everyone again.
Taking huge steps, he walked up to Shiba, opening and closing his huge mouth, "Hey, old lion, you are so uninterested, you didn't even call me Kuyatta in the fight."
"You lazy guy, don't you like sleeping the most? Last time I went to find you, I had to wait for half a month." A loud roar also emerged from the open and closed mouth of Shiba.
"Hehe..."
"Kuyata, Shiba, don't think that I will be afraid of you. If you existed before me, how could you dare to challenge the majesty of my black dragon." A dragon roar mixed with human language came out of Yafit's mouth.
"Hmph, Yafit, don't think that the forest of death, is your dragon fortress, our monsters in the Death Forest have never been afraid of your dragons, and you also know that it was you before, I only know that we will not be afraid of you now. "Kuyatta let out a cold snort.
Shiba nodded at the giant star repeatedly to express his approval.
"A dead cow is so rampant. I'm here to see what other abilities you have besides finding people. "Black old Yafit cursed angrily, flapped his giant wings, and swooped towards Kuyata.
"Han Yue, you look for an opportunity to strike. Shiba and I will stop it. "
He raised his head and roared loudly, and countless wind blades swept towards Yafit, and the lion bar next to him also spit out a wind blade.
Looking at the wind blade coming at a rapid speed, Yaphet spurted out the corrosive dragon breath, disappearing it completely.
A mocking voice came out, "Kuata, are you the only one who knows how to use such a weak magic? This can't even cut through my scales. "
Ignoring the black dragon's ridicule, Kuyata let out a loud roar, and the surrounding trees began to grow crazily. The tree trunks, which were more than ten meters thick, were like poisonous snakes, twisting towards Yafit in the air.
